title.zh: 新 Salesforce 线索同步到 Slack
title.en: New Salesforce lead, straight to Slack

description.zh: 新线索到达时，立即通知对应频道。
description.en: Notify the right channel the moment a new lead comes in.

title.zh: 成交后自动创建 Stripe 账单

description.zh: 成交后立即生成并发送账单。
description.en: Auto-generate and send the invoice as soon as a deal closes.

title.zh: Calendly 预约同步 CRM 联系人

description.zh: 每次预约都创建联系人并设置跟进提醒。
description.en: Create the contact and set a follow-up reminder on every booking.

title.zh: 新工单自动进入分流频道
title.en: New ticket to Slack triage channel

description.zh: 每张新工单立即进入正确的频道。
description.en: Every new support ticket lands in the right channel instantly.

description.zh: 人工打开工单前，先准备常见问题回复草稿。
description.en: Draft a first-pass reply for common tickets before an agent opens them.

title.zh: 表单提交同步邮件与频道
title.en: Form submit to Mailchimp and Slack

description.zh: 新注册用户自动打标签、接收邮件并通知团队。
description.en: Every new signup gets tagged, emailed, and announced.

title.zh: AI 自动生成内容提纲

description.zh: 把一行主题转为 Notion 中的完整内容提纲。
description.en: Turn a one-line prompt into a full content brief in Notion.

title.zh: GitHub 合并请求同步 Slack 与 Linear
title.en: GitHub PR to Slack and Linear

description.zh: 通知代码审阅者，同时更新关联问题。
description.en: Reviewers get pinged and the linked issue updates itself.

title.zh: CI 失败时提醒值班工程师

description.zh: 构建失败时，几秒内提醒值班工程师。
description.en: A red build pages the on-call engineer within seconds.

title.zh: 使用 AI 分流缺陷报告

description.zh: 自动标记、排序并分配新问题。
description.en: New issues get labeled, prioritized, and assigned automatically.

description.zh: 第一天就备好 Slack 频道与 Notion 清单。
description.en: A new Slack channel and Notion checklist, ready on day one.

description.zh: 将申请交给正确审批人，并同步决策结果。
description.en: Requests route to the right approver and post the decision to Slack.

title.en: New payment to Slack and log

description.zh: 每次支付发生时立即记录并通知。
description.en: Every payment gets logged and announced the moment it lands.

title.zh: 支付失败，自动重试并提醒

description.zh: 自动重试，连续失败两次后提醒财务。
description.en: Retries fire automatically and finance gets an alert if it fails twice.

title.zh: 通过短信提醒逾期账单

description.zh: 无需人工操作，温和提醒逾期账单。
description.en: Overdue invoices get a friendly nudge without anyone lifting a finger.
